result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭與 second-source 兩軸在證據包內沒有負向 finding；商業太空客戶自建工廠的風險已列入 threats，無漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats[0]","reason":"供需持久性軸沒有未接的負向條目；氦氣 geo_supply_chain#1 已寫進 threats、R3 和 bear 說明，並附供給恢復後回落的機率 40%。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.evidence_dismissed","reason":"負向 finding 都有去處：關稅進 threats，俄羅斯、慕尼黑訴訟、FDA 483、歐洲弱需求、2026-10-17 共識進 R／contradictions，葡萄牙併購審查列入 evidence_dismissed 並附理由。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"裁決為觀望，wait_for_price=true，條件為股價 ≤460 美元且 2027 年指引中點年增 ≥8%，具體可驗；market_wrong_reason_given=false 與觀望結果一致。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots","reason":"12 軸皆 found，無空軸；q6 事實表自陳的 qa_flags 缺口，判斷已逐條列出四個未正面回答的問題，並註明只有 Lincare FCF 為正在 Q3 補充。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"roiic 與 reinvest_rate 因缺投入資本與折舊攤銷只給代理值，endo_ceiling 為 null，屬資料缺口且已明說；情境樹與 scenario_meta 對得上（bull 28.3×29=820.7、bear 18.1×20=362、ev5y 20.7%、asym 2.0），Bull/Base 價差實質。小瑕疵：基本情境 2027 年 EPS 19.0（+6.2%）已低於自己的 H2 門檻 19.3（+8%），卻在觸發器寫指引 <8% 才下修基本情境到 18.6，兩者不同調。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots[0].evidence_refs","reason":"營運指標全用 Q3 2026（2026-10-29）數字，沒有比 as_of 更舊的項目；但歐洲 R1／blind_spot 引用的 end_markets#2 是 2025-10-31 的 call 說法，時效偏舊，屬資料級。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"無前份（no_prior_dd），不適用漂移歸因。"}]
